reasons: Claimed status is compliant and no redline or comment was proposed — the rendered text is identical to the originals, which is correct for a compliant finding.

The cited paragraphs support the conclusion: § 4.1 (p0052) ties Charges to one-time/installment/recurring/usage amounts specified in Order Forms and Service Option Attachments, with no minimum, take-or-pay, shortfall or volume-cap language anywhere in the cited text.

p0142 (Capacity Planning) is correctly read as allocating forecasting responsibility to Customer, not imposing a committed volume, and § 14.11 (no resale) is a use restriction rather than a volume restriction.
Customer's monthly termination-for-convenience right (p0044) confirms no multi-year lock-in in the Base Terms, so the clause meets the preferred position.
The early-termination-charge reference in p0046 is appropriately flagged as diligence only and deferred to the termination rule, avoiding double-flagging the same commercial term.
